tasks.description: Choose a payment provider to integrate with the app. This will require research and discussion with finance and legal teams. The chosen provider should support multiple currencies and have a good reputation for security.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of payment providers, when the team evaluates them, then the best provider is chosen based on security, cost, and features.

tasks.description: Work with finance and legal teams to determine the plan tiers and their prices. This will involve discussing revenue goals, competition, and target audience.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of revenue goals, when the team discusses plan tiers and prices, then a set of tiered plans with prices is defined.

tasks.description: Integrate the chosen payment provider with the app's backend. This will involve writing code to handle payment processing, including handling successful and failed payments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's payment information, when the payment is processed, then the payment is successfully completed or an error message is displayed.

tasks.description: Implement tax handling for payments. This will involve calculating tax based on the user's location and adding it to the payment amount.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's location, when a payment is processed, then the correct tax amount is added to the payment.

tasks.description: Define and implement a refund policy for payments. This will involve discussing with finance and legal teams to determine the refund policy and then implementing it in the app.
acceptance_criteria: Given a refund request, when the refund policy is applied, then the refund is processed correctly.

tasks.description: Design and implement a user interface for payments. This will involve creating a payment form and integrating it with the payment processing code.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they navigate to the payment page, then a payment form is displayed with the correct payment options.

tasks.description: Implement subscription activation after a successful payment. This will involve updating the user's account status and sending a confirmation email.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful payment, when the subscription is activated, then the user's account status is updated and a confirmation email is sent.

tasks.description: Test the payment flow to ensure it works correctly. This will involve testing different payment scenarios, including successful and failed payments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment scenario, when the payment flow is tested, then the payment is processed correctly and any errors are handled correctly.
